## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. I won’t tell you not to quit, but before you make a decision tomorrow, could we talk tonight and think through your options? If the job is harming your health or safety, leaving may be the right choice—but it might help to check your finances, benefits, notice requirements, and whether you can take a day off first. Whatever you decide, you don’t have to handle it alone.

## 2

I understand why some images might seem easy to manipulate, especially when they come through media or agencies you don’t personally know. But the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend on a single photograph. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth casts a round shadow during lunar eclipses, and time zones and satellite communication all fit a globe far better than a flat-Earth model. These observations can be tested independently, and many of them were known long before modern space photography existed.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it’s actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. That’s why the sky looks blue when the Sun is high. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue and leaves more red, orange, and pink light coming toward us.

雨从傍晚一直下到深夜，像一层细密的帘子，把城市笼在朦胧的水汽里。路灯映在积水中，随着雨点的敲打，碎成一片片摇晃的金黄。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，轮胎卷起白亮的水花，转眼又消失在街角。屋檐下，有人抱着书安静等候，雨声盖住了喧闹，也让夜晚显得格外漫长而温柔。窗内的灯光透过玻璃，暖暖地照着潮湿的世界。
